# External figures used in STA1000 lecture slides

Every file in this folder was taken from a publicly available university course
repository and is used here for teaching. Filenames carry a source prefix.

## `mgt100_*` — Kenneth C. Wilbur and Daniel Yavorsky, *Customer Analytics* (MGT 100), UC San Diego Rady School of Management
<https://github.com/kennethcwilbur/mgt100>
Licensed **CC BY 4.0**. The authors state on their title slide: "We welcome
reuse with attribution. Please share widely."

## `smm635_*` — Simone Santoni, *Data Visualisation* (SMM635), Bayes Business School, City St George's, University of London
<https://github.com/simoneSantoni/data-viz-smm635>
No licence file in the repository. Used for non-commercial university teaching
with attribution. Several of these figures are themselves reproductions of
Edward Tufte's work in *The Visual Display of Quantitative Information* and
*Visual Explanations*, credited on the slide where they appear.

## `mcllm_*` — Alex van Vorstenbosch, *Masterclass: LLMs for Data Science*
<https://github.com/avvorstenbosch/Masterclass-LLMs-for-Data-Science>
Licensed **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**. Non-commercial use with attribution, share-alike.

## `ubc_*` — UBC Master of Data Science, *Programming in Python for Data Science*
<https://github.com/UBC-MDS/programming-in-python-for-data-science>
No licence file in the repository. Used for non-commercial university teaching
with attribution.

## `ds701_*` — Boston University, *DS701 Tools for Data Science*
<https://github.com/tools4ds/DS701-Course-Notes>
No licence file in the repository. Used for non-commercial university teaching
with attribution.

## `qd_*` — Mine Cetinkaya-Rundel, *Quarto Dashboards* workshop, posit::conf(2024)
<https://github.com/posit-conf-2024/quarto-dashboards>
Screenshots of example dashboards. Used for non-commercial university teaching
with attribution.

## Note on third-party content
Several figures are screenshots or reproductions of material the course authors
did not themselves own (newspaper graphics, journal figures, corporate
screenshots). A repository licence cannot grant rights the repository owner does
not hold. Use in a closed university lecture is the normal educational case; if
any of these decks are published openly, the individually sourced figures should
be reviewed.
